name: starflask_get_media
description: Fetch metadata and a fresh downloadable URL for a Starflask media item by id. Returns {id, url, content_type, width, height, file_size, created_at}. The `url` is a presigned link valid for about an hour — use it to download or re-share media (e.g. a previously uploaded file, or media referenced by id). Note: completed job results already include ready-to-use URLs in their result object, so you usually only need this to refresh an expired URL.

media_id.description: The UUID of the media item.
